Narrator: Our tale begins on a planet much like Earth, in an epoch far removed from our own.
Narrator: There lived a deity named Elion, ancient being of immense power and wisdom, concealed in an eternally youthful form.
Narrator: Oblivious to his divine nature, Elion interacted with humans, exploring their world and wondering at the beauty they created.
Elion: The emotions in their art, the depth in their words. It all seems beyond my reach.
Narrator: He might have been ageless and wise beyond comprehension, but the humanity, the raw emotion eluded him.
Narrator: One day, he crossed paths with Iris, a mortal woman of exceptional beauty and grace.
Iris: What a lovely day, isn't it?
Elion: Yes, it is. I couldn't help but notice your radiant smile.
Narrator: Iris, unaware of Elion's divine nature, simply saw a kindred spirit, someone who relished the world as much as she did.
Narrator: As time went by, Elion increasingly found himself drawn to Iris, wondering if he could someday understand and embody the humanity that she exuded.
Narrator: Could a deity, he wondered, ever fall in love?
